label: clean
why: Verbose service-split refactor; 6 files inside the named package, none named individually.

session.prompt_summary: Break the monolithic order service into smaller pieces inside the orders package: separate pricing, inventory checks, and fulfilment into their own classes with explicit constructor injection, preserving every existing public method signature and the database transaction boundaries.
